title: SENTO SURVIVOR : Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
description:
Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!

Welcome to a chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse)!

On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble your way to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

Over 30 Stages!Triumph in Deathmatch and Survival stages to claim your victory bath!

Out of Control!? Super Slippery FloorsChaos is guaranteed on these slippery floors! Watch out, because bumping into rivals will send you tumbling!

Choose Your Character and Water Gun!Pick from 4 unique playable characters and 4 different types of water guns! Find your favorite combination and conquer the stage!

Go Wild with Special Weapons!Special weapons that appear mid-game are incredibly powerful! Grab them before your rivals do! If an opponent gets one first, you're in big trouble!! Take them down and snatch it for yourself!

Get a Temporary Boost with Items!Power-up items will also appear, giving you a temporary attack boost or even making you invincible! Grab them to get a leg up on the competition!

Dramatic GimmicksJet showers erupting from the floor, giant rubber ducks... the stages are full of various gimmicks! Why are these things in a bathhouse? That remains an eternal mystery...

4-Player Local MultiplayerGet the party started with up to 4-player local multiplayer! Set your own house rules for even more chaotic fun!

Worldview"The time has finally come!"

The "Great Sento Festival," held once every four years, has begun!

It's a festival of pride-staking battles where "Sento Masters"—those who love baths with all their heart—compete to prove their devotion!

Now, show everyone a love that burns hotter than the steaming hot water itself!

※ Notice ※When visiting a real Sento, please be mindful of the rules and etiquette to ensure a pleasant experience for everyone.
